description:
Acquire a cooperative lock for the smallest critical section that controls or depends on transient shared Editor state: Play/Pause/Edit Mode, explicit recompilation/domain reload, active scene/Prefab Stage, Selection, or window focus. Acquire immediately before the first such operation and release after the last state-dependent call.

Explicit-target asset/code edits, searches, creation, imports, and ordinary verification remain outside the lock. This decision depends on shared state, independently of readonly; Unity tools remain callable without the lock.

wait queues in FIFO order until acquisition, cancellation, or timeout. try returns a non-error busy result with holder details when an active holder/waiter exists and reclaims inactive holders. Reacquisition by the owner is idempotent.

reason.description: Short description of only the direct Editor-state control or dependency inside this minimal critical section, shown to Agents waiting for the lock. Do not list asset or code edits.

mode.description: Acquisition behavior. `wait` queues until the lock is acquired; `try` returns immediately when an active session owns the lock or another session is already queued.

timeout_seconds.description: Maximum time to wait for the cooperative lock. Defaults to 300 seconds.
